propositions: When structured-parse retries exhaust in the prompted branch of _pai_structured, raw reply text is discarded and failures are not replayable; the requested feature adds opt-in artifact capture on final failure.

The new config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (default None) must be added as a field on LLMConfig and resolved in from_env via _llm_str with CLI/env/file/default precedence, following the existing pattern for other llm.* keys.

On final parse-failure before raise last, when the config key resolves to a non-empty path, write one timestamped artifact containing raw reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count; append the artifact path to the raised error message.
The artifact write is best-effort and wrapped to never mask the original parse error; the directory is created if absent and rotated by mtime to retain at most 20 artifacts per directory.
With the key unset (default), behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged and no artifacts are written; successful parses never trigger artifact capture even when the key is set.
